# Results: Anatomy or Acquisition?

Every number below is rendered from `results/json/*.json` by `scripts/research/render_results.py`. Estimates are point [95% patient-clustered bootstrap CI] (B = 2,000). Δ values are paired.
*Illustrative re-analysis of publicly available datasets; not a clinical study.*

## Data

FETAL_PLANES_DB: 12,400 images from 1,792 patients. External sets:

| set | images | patients |
|---|---|---|
| HC18 | 999 | 806 |
| UCL | 424 | 51 |
| African (5 centres) | 450 | 127 |

Details are in `DATA_CARDS.md`.

|---|---|
| FPDB-test 8-way macro-F1 | 0.893 [0.883, 0.902] (n = 5,271 images, 896 patients) |

## RQ1: is acquisition entangled with the label, and do models encode it?

- **Confound (E1).** 'Other' is 65.1% [60.3, 69.2] of Aloka training images vs 13.6% [9.7, 18.0] of Voluson E6 images. The difference (Aloka − E6) is 51.5% [45.0, 57.4]. Cramér's V (machine × class): 0.323 [0.296, 0.427].
- **No-pixel model (E2, P1a).** AUROC for standard plane vs Other on seen machines:
  - machine + operator: 0.735 [0.714, 0.751] (n = 4,200 images, 808 patients)
  - adding frame geometry: 0.872 [0.854, 0.887]
  - Δ for geometry: +0.137 [+0.122, +0.154], p = 0.0005
  - full-image classifier, for reference: 0.974 [0.966, 0.980]
- **Decodability (E3, P1b).** Machine decoded within one true class (convnext_tiny features): 0.958 [0.948, 0.967] (n = 3,275 images, 543 patients). ImageNet features: 0.998 [0.996, 0.999]. Fine-tuned − ImageNet: -0.040 [-0.050, -0.031], p = 0.0005.
- **Stratified performance (E6, P1c).** 'Other' recall (convnext_tiny):

  | machine | 'Other' recall |
  |---|---|
  | Aloka | 0.952 [0.935, 0.967] |
  | Voluson E6 | 0.521 [0.453, 0.587] |
  | Voluson S10 | 0.920 [0.892, 0.948] |

  S10 − E6: 0.399 [0.323, 0.471] (n = 5,271 images, 896 patients). The pre-specified direction of P1c is refuted.

## RQ2: is the label learnable from, and do models use, non-anatomical content?

- **Availability (E4, P2a).** 8-way balanced accuracy, where chance is 0.125:
  - with the anatomy blanked: 0.480 [0.466, 0.492] (n = 5,271 images, 896 patients)
  - sector shape alone: 0.436 [0.419, 0.452]
  - no-pixel prior: 0.198 [0.186, 0.209]
- **Reliance (E5, P2b).** Zeroing everything outside the fan sector changes 1.0% [0.7, 1.3] of convnext_tiny's 8-way predictions.

## RQ3: does saliency fall on the anatomy, and does that predict correctness?

- **Gate G3.** The method passed the randomisation sanity check: Grad-CAM yes, Grad-CAM++ yes, occlusion yes.
- **On-anatomy saliency (P3a).** EPG − area for convnext_tiny Grad-CAM on FPDB-test:

  | anatomy | EPG − area |
  |---|---|
  | Head | 0.254 [0.242, 0.266] |
  | Abdomen | 0.156 [0.138, 0.172] |
  | Femur | 0.069 [0.064, 0.074] |

  Femur − Head:

  | model | Grad-CAM | occlusion (16-px patches) |
  |---|---|---|
  | convnext_tiny | -0.185 [-0.198, -0.171] | -0.112 [-0.140, -0.085] |
  | tf_efficientnetv2_s | -0.406 [-0.412, -0.399] | 0.199 [0.172, 0.223] |

  Under occlusion the sign reverses for every backbone except convnext_tiny (`R4_localisation.md`). The "femur lowest" pattern therefore depends on the resolution of the saliency method.
- **E7: out-of-sector saliency (convnext_tiny).**
  - FPDB-test: 0.144 [0.136, 0.151], against a uniform-map baseline of 0.182
  - Aloka − E6: 0.069 [0.057, 0.081]
- **Association (P3b, exploratory).** EPG − area against external correctness, primary model:
  - OR per +0.1: 0.99 [0.86, 1.15]
  - AUROC: 0.520 [0.473, 0.565], against confidence 0.823 [0.787, 0.858]
- **Ground-truth-free monitor on the African set.** Out-of-sector share of the predicted-class map:
  - AUROC: 0.778 [0.718, 0.832]
  - Δ AUROC over confidence: +0.133 [+0.059, +0.207], p = 0.0005

## Deviations

**2026-11-12 — R0 — Repository restructure**

- split hashes use LF-normalised bytes (repo has core.autocrlf=true; raw-byte hashes would depend on checkout settings).
- forbidden-token leakage check inspects the repo-relative path (or only the file name for files outside the repo) instead of the full absolute path; the absolute-path version false-positived on temp folders such as `pytest-…`.
- `requirements-lock.txt` listed pandas 3.0.5 but the environment has 2.3.3; the lock now reflects the installed environment.

**2026-11-12 — R1 — Data foundation (Gate G1)**

- binary audit rated by a vision model (`claude-vision`) from contact sheets instead of a human, at the PI's request; rater was blind to detector output for caliper/text ratings.
- FP↔FPDB registration replaced by an exact identity check (images are pixel-identical).
- HC18/UCL patient IDs from filename prefixes (annotation SubjectID columns empty).
- abdominal landmark QC uses a mid-point offset bound of 0.30 (head 0.15); TAD/APAD caliper pairs do not bisect each other.
- sector consensus prior = union with a 0.95-coverage train-only "core" (plan: intersection with a majority mask). Observed failures were under-inclusion, and a majority mask covered 92–95% of the frame.
- caliper detector recall 0.20 (train) after one tuning round; dotted-line scoring disabled (fired on speckle). Per the pre-specified rule, no manual masks were used.

**2026-11-12 — R2 — Evaluation core and re-evaluation of the six frozen checkpoints (Gate G2)**

- in-distribution scorer and metric factories are in `src/eval/scoring.py`; `external.py` only holds external scoring (plan put everything in `external.py`).
- the image-level CI column is reported for all six backbones, not only convnext. Per-machine macro-F1 averages over the classes present on that machine.
- macro-F1 excludes classes whose F1 is undefined in a resample (TP+FP+FN = 0). This equals sklearn on the full test set.
- a `RatioMetric` fast path (sum/sum ratios) was added next to the confusion-matrix fast path.
- G2 macro-F1 targets for the five other backbones use the 4-decimal values in archive/docs/EVAL_REPORT.md, not the 2-decimal classification reports. This is stricter.
- extra analyses not in the plan: pairwise comparison on the legacy endpoint (HC18+UCL acc_full), HC18+UCL legacy-set table, and errors on contradictory duplicates.
- `src/__init__.py` added; it sets `NO_ALBUMENTATIONS_UPDATE=1`, because albumentations' import-time version check made network calls and once timed out during the run.

**2026-11-12 — R3.E1 — Descriptive confounding**

- strata with < 10 patients get no CI (S10 train+val: 11 images from 1 patient).

**2026-11-12 — R3.E2 — No-pixel metadata model (P1a)**

- `overlay` features use only the validated UI detector (G1); caliper features excluded. The planned footnote "geometry ≈ prior is expected" was replaced by a data-driven sentence plus paired AUROC contrasts, because geometry clearly exceeds the prior.

**2026-11-12 — R3.E6 — Stratified performance (P1c)**

- overlay strata not run (G1: caliper detector not validated; UI present on 100% of images). GEE (exchangeable) odds ratios reported as supplementary.

**2026-11-12 — R3.E3 — Feature decodability (P1b)**

- probe solver unchanged (sklearn lbfgs) but run with single-threaded BLAS in torch-free worker processes; a torch L-BFGS solver was written, validated and then removed when BLAS oversubscription turned out to be the cause of slowness.

**2026-11-12 — R3.E5 — Reliance perturbations (P2b)**

- `a_marker`, `c_control` (the pre-declared primary contrast) and `d_pairs` not run (G1). Text drawn on top of the anatomy is not detected at pixel level and is left in place; E5 measures out-of-sector reliance only (coverage table in E5.md).

**2026-11-12 — R3.E4 — Availability: training without anatomy (P2a)**

- cached modes are stored pre-resized to 224 px (identical pixels to on-the-fly resizing; tested) instead of native resolution, for training speed. `nonanat_only` keeps one in-sector grey level per image.
- RESULTS.md "RQ1–RQ2" section is rendered in R6 (`render_results.py` does not exist yet); all numbers are in results/json/E1–E6.json. E7 (saliency out-of-sector fraction) runs in R4 as planned.

**2026-11-13 — R4.1–R4.4 — Saliency API, anatomy masks, metrics, development on val**

- raw CAMs (library min-max scaling overridden); exact pixel-centre rasterisation of masks instead of `cv2.ellipse` (cv2 boundary pixels inflated thin femur capsules by > 5%, failing the plan's area test); EfficientNetV2-S occlusion patch 20 / stride 10 (2:1 ratio kept); occlusion under fp16 autocast.
- speed fixes that leave outputs unchanged (verified): fixed-size CAM batches (each new input shape cost ~5 s of cuDNN set-up), CAM backward stops at the target layer, vectorised occlusion, thread-based input loading (DataLoader workers took ~30 s each to start on Windows).

**2026-11-13 — R4.5 — Gate G3 (model-parameter randomisation)**

- ConvNeXt layer-scale `gamma` vectors keep trained values during re-initialisation (block-level parameters, not sub-modules); maps compared after positive part and per-map max scaling.

**2026-11-13 — R4.6 — Locked localisation run + E7 (legacy checkpoints)**

- overlay fraction uses the R1 UI mask only; the "with vs without overlays" split was not run (G1); sector-aware EPG uses mask ∩ sector in numerator and baseline; 6 zero-energy Grad-CAM maps (HC18) excluded as undefined.

**2026-11-13 — R4.7 — Association with external correctness (P3b, exploratory)**

- the plan's "deployable" `epg_pred` still uses the expert mask of the true anatomy and is favoured by construction for wrong predictions (AUROC 0.97); it is reported with that warning and not interpreted. `--report-only` added to re-render without the 13-min bootstrap.

## Limitations

- **Public data only.** FPDB comes from one centre and four device groups; external sets are small (UCL 51 pregnancies; African 5 centres, 450 images). Nothing here is a clinical claim.
- **Overlay detection.** The caliper detector failed validation (Gate G1), so the overlay analyses are limited to UI and text outside the sector.
- **Saliency.** Saliency metrics depend on method resolution and mask area. EPG is reported with its area baseline, and "deployable" EPG variants still need expert masks.
- **Prior knowledge.** The legacy-model results (R1–R4) were known before the R5 protocol was registered.
